k_psi.method: 3-D magnetostatic Stage A (I = 0): axial mean of the gap fundamental over the stack / the 2-D gap fundamental (k_flux_self × B1_mid,3D / B1_2D), at this machine's own stack; today's die cross-section, n_stack 4 (quick fidelity)

k_T.method: INHERITED Stage B (co-energy, matched 2-D window) k_T = 0.97947 at 12 mm on the 2026-08 geometry bb30c0242629c6ea (B15AHV950M / F45SH), scaled by the end-region law 1 − (1 − k_T12)·12/L — not recomputed (Stage B/D cost ~2 660 s per rotor position)

k_L.method: Stage B long-stack test: L(L) = a·L + b (stack incl. end region); k_L = L/(a·L) = 1 + b/(a·L)

magnet_segmentation.note: magnets are one axial piece; rotor/magnet eddy loss is a 2-D (infinitely long, no axial return path) value — an axially unsegmented magnet of length L carries its eddy current along L and returns at the ends, so the 2-D value is an UPPER bound; segmentation is not modelled
